reviews.text: My dog Leo got groomed at Urban Canine Doggy Day Spa on Tuesday and it was WONDERFUL! Tony was extremely kind and understanding and Leo left looking, smelling, and feeling like 1M bucks 🐶 we noticed that he was very happy because after a groom he doesn’t like he would get home and turn into a ball, this time he just wanted to play and show everyone his new look! We are so happy our neighbor recommended us this groomer!!
thank you melanie

New-ish to the area and needed to find a local groomer. Cannot recommend this place enough! Super friendly and professional staff, reasonable prices, and hours of operation made scooting my pooch in easy with my schedule. Probably the best groom/bath my little lady has gotten. Will definitely be back!

I’ve been bringing my dog to Urban Canine for the last few years and love them. Tony and team are always so welcoming and do a wonderful job with Oliver. I’d highly recommend bringing your pup here for all of their grooming needs.
They are the best groomers! They’re friendly, fast, and great at what they do. Thank you!
Great communication especially about expectations. They were also able to give me a heads up on when they would be finished since my dog tends to lean anxious. Thanks y'all.

Excellent local shop for dog grooming! The staff is friendly and professional, and our dog's grooming is typically completed within 1-2 hours. Urban Canine does a wonderful job making our dog feel comfortable-she 's always excited to arrive and see the staff. 5/5 stars!
Every experience I've had has been great! Great with the animals and friendly service.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We had such a great experience at Urban Canine Doggy Day Spa! They took wonderful care of my Doberman, Flair, and did an excellent job. Dobermans can be sensitive, and the team handled Flair with so much patience, confidence, and kindness—it really shows how much they understand dogs. Tony and the team are professional, welcoming, and clearly passionate about what they do. Flair came home happy, calm, and looking fantastic. Highly recommend Urban Canine to anyone looking for a place they can truly trust with their dog!
We love Urban Canine! Tony and his team are friendly and professional. Our dog can be pretty anxious during grooming, but they always take great care of her
Tony and team are awesome. Highly recommend. Very reasonable pricing for an exceptional service

Evelyn has groomed my golden retriever 3x now and she’s always done an amazing job! She will even send photos/videos of him during the groom. Best grooming experience I’ve had in Chicago (and we’ve been to a lot of different groomers lol) and pretty affordable prices for a golden retriever!
Took my pup here for his first grooming. The prices are very reasonable. He looked and smelled great! Will be coming back.
My dog gave them a hard time with a grooming, but they did the best they and it came out great still.
We love taking our dogs here. They always smell so good and look so fresh when we pick up them. Thank you Tony! Highly recommend.
Thank you for your review!
We take both our dogs here and they do a great job!
Everybody there is so kind and they have got a great operation going. On top of that, my dog looks amazing and was happy. Which can be rare with grooming experiences. Here she is a couple days later
Everyone here at Urban are very friendly and patient 😊 easy to book, haven’t taken my dog anywhere else …

⸻

I want to give a special thanks to Evelyn for the excellent care she has provided for my pet. She clearly has a deep connection with animals and has completely earned my trust. She is dedicated, compassionate, and truly professional.Thank you eve ..!
I found Evelyn on Instagram looking to groom my dog for the first time. Every time we go they do a great job. I love that they take pictures sometimes during her time there.

Heartfelt disappointment. I’ve been bringing my dog here for about a year.  Initially it was great. However, the last few times the results have been rough. Her previous trim was patchy, and her most recent groom on 05/02 resulted in an uneven shave down and patches of cut hair throughout the top which I asked to leave long.
Thank you for the review!

What an amazing experience from the moment we walked in to the time we picked up our dog. The staff was so friendly, the place was clean and pleasant, and our dog wasn’t stressed out. The quality of the grooming service was also outstanding. Would definitely recommend this place!
Thanks so much for you nice review, we really appreciate it!
Best doggy spa. The only place I would take my pet over and over again

I used to take my pug, Oyster, somewhere else until a friend introduced us to Evelyn at Urban Canine. Evelyn is great with Oyster, especially with nail trimming. Friendly and wonderful staff..Highly recommended place!
Great location and quick service and scheduling. Reasonable pricing as well. Will use again.
Happy I found this place when I needed a new groomer. I tried myself but couldn't get my dog to stay still. Evelyn does a great job. Highly recommend this place.
I love this place. I’ve been bringing my puppy here since I got him and Evelyn always does an awesome job! Definitely will continue coming here.

Evelyn did such a great job with my Rexy. She is a puggle that does not like having her paws touched I can never manage to groom her myself. Evelyn is great with her and I would definitely continue to go to her. The staff is nice and you can tell they love their job.
The groomers did a great job with my Shorkie. He has not had the best history with other groomers but they were able to get the job done!

Highly recommend! I have taken my Australian Shepard puppy here twice and it has been a wonderful experience. Bonus, they are usually able to fit you in same day or week of! Definitely my go to spot 🐶🫧 …
